subject: Therapist accused of kicking 5-year-old child with autism in the face at care fa...
posts:
A care facility is meant to be a sanctuary, but a shocking allegation reveals the ultimate betrayal of trust.

Therapist Accused of Kicking Child
Evidence: professional therapy, physical abuse, safe environment

Therapists at specialized care facilities claim to provide safe, therapeutic interventions to help vulnerable children develop.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

An employee allegedly kicked a non-verbal 5-year-old child with autism directly in the face inside the facility.
Resulting Judgement: (-2.0, -2.0) — Tyranny

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
An institution built for healing becomes a site of active, violent extraction against the most defenseless.
A therapist at a specialized care facility has been arrested and accused of child abuse after allegedly kicking a five-year-old autistic child in the face during a session.

The Bright Side:
Dedicated therapists worldwide continue to provide life-changing, compassionate care to neurodivergent children every day.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
They frame this as a localized behavioral management issue (WHAT). It is a failure of Will (WHO) and basic humanity.

Bait: professional healing. Switch: physical violence against a defenseless child.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between professional care standards and violent abuse, it plots a direct trajectory toward Tyranny. When power is used to extract safety from a child, the system collapses into pure harm.

The Unavoidable Truth: Vulnerable children are entirely at the mercy of their caregivers.

The Unavoidable Lie: That this was a standard therapeutic restraint.

Alethekanon:
Abuse under the guise of therapy is a systemic failure. When the protector becomes the predator, the entire institutional contract is voided.

Awwthekanon:
This is heartbreaking. A five-year-old child deserves absolute safety, gentle patience, and love, not fear and pain. We must protect them.

Brothekanon:
Kicking a five-year-old kid in the face? Especially one with autism? That is not therapy, that is straight-up villain behavior. Lock them up.

Synthesized Resolution Vector:
Blended Path: The Path of Deception — Stated care collapses to Tyranny when violence replaces therapy.
Final Recalculated Coordinates: (-2.0, -2.0)
